sources.snippet: Synapse AI Chat goes beyond a typical chatbot, it builds and maintains a persistent knowledge graph about each user across every conversation. The system automatically ingests conversations into a Neo4j-backed knowledge graph via Synapse Cortex, compiles that knowledge, and injects it into future AI interactions. sources.snippet: Synapse AI Chat 🧠 Your Intelligent Gateway to Real-Time Knowledge & Deep Research. Synapse AI Chat is a comprehensive AI-powered assistant designed for real-time information retrieval and deep analysis. Unlike static AI models, Synapse leverages a Search-First Approach, fetching the latest data from the web, academic journals, and video platforms to ensure answers are factual and current.
